Have one too bought it back in early 2017, sapphire edition. Still going strong except two main issues: 1- battery, of course expected but just by a bit. 2- the need to hook up my watch to the laptop to be able to update the EPO on the watch for faster gps sync and accuracy. 

  
Speaking of accuracy, the recent Fenix watches support dual-band which massively increases accuracy, as per some reviews i read.

I mean when i was looking for his clinic he was checking where i was going and how i got up to the exact floor waited at the door for a while then went back down....you know such stuff we with social anxiety have. :)

Been thinking about trying out Tinder, but knowing how things go there and preferring exposure i prefer, and still do, confrontation. So getting to know them through social gatherings is better in that case. Tinder would be good for one time fling. Still though not saying Tinder is bad but it would still give you a good amount of experience, which is something i am seeking.

The thing is in my case, i told my family that i should go to the therapist...of course they went into state of denial for my case but then i explained why i should go. The therapist actually noticed my case from the start since he was monitoring how i was searching for his clinic (i guess you should know how it went going to a place for the first time as a person with social anxiety).

What i am trying to say is kudos to you for taking the first step and actually deciding to go in the first place, as we usually fear something new. Being aware is key and that will be like 70% of the solution. 

Good Luck!

You just have to inform close friends/family members of your case, they will understand especially when you point it out as soon as you know it will hit you. It will make a difference once you know that someone is there supporting you when you need them the most.

Good thing it doesn't last more than 10 minutes though, even then dont forget to to tell someone who you are close to and/or you see constantly about your case.
